title: RETAIN Agent State Store
description: The threshold classification of a persistent agent state store. Every persistent store is exactly one of residue, domain, or brain (RETAIN 2.1).

heldBy.description: The agent identity whose state this is. Exactly one; two agents MUST NOT share a brain (RETAIN 4.1).

threshold.description: Residue is governed by TRACE. A domain is the principal's Layer 2 topology. A brain is a party.

persistsAcrossEngagement.description: False forces threshold residue. A store discarded at engagement end MUST NOT be classified as a domain or a brain (RETAIN 2.2).

keyHolder.description: The operative test. A store whose key is held by another party is a domain of that party, whatever it is called (RETAIN 2.4).

isSelf.description: False is incompatible with threshold brain. A brain the parent can sign for is a folder with aspirations.

placement.description: A declared property per store, not a system wide design choice. Undeclared placement is C4 (RETAIN 5.1).

privacyBasis.description: Inspectability and ownership trade against each other. Claiming construction while operating as policy is RT-13.

retainsByConstruction.description: An agent that learns retains. A no retention classification is RT-12 (RETAIN 5.4).

hasOwnDeclaration.description: MUST be true for a brain and false for a domain. A domain inherits the principal's entirely (RETAIN 4.3).

charterArtifactClass.description: A domain's behavioral rules are directive artifacts under TRACE, not a values document.

amendableByPrincipal.description: True only for a domain. A principal amending a brain's POLARIS is RT-07.

capacities.description: The three capacities that constitute an agent's ownership. All three or none; partial holdings resolve by the key holding test (RETAIN 4.2).

sharedStores.description: Legal among domains, forbidden between brains. Each entry is a promotion blocker (RETAIN 3.4).

dissolutionPlan.description: How shared state becomes pairwise utterances with receipts.

creation.description: Required for threshold brain. Creation is owner only and never delegable (RETAIN 10.1).

consequenceClass.description: K4 where the new brain or its owner is to hold an envelope in the creating brain.

disposition.description: Declared at creation, before any party has an interest in the answer (RETAIN 10.3).

orphaned.description: An orphan holds records and no party holds its refusal. Unreported is RT-38.
